summary: Operator's pages re-read: the 2026 season (April 9 - November 1) and the posted rates ($28-50 + tax) match the entry's 2026-10-13 values. Nothing new written.
flags: Fees base (an earlier human check, so not overwritten): nightly_low 28 is the Wooded Primitive site ('Our wooded sites marked in brown are primitive. W1 to W6 are better suited for tents, small popups and truck campers may fit. W14 is big enough for a 30ft camper or so if you are up for boon docking'), and primitive sites pay 'one time $10 fee for camper/RV fill up and/or use dump station'. The cheapest site a 23-ft motorhome plainly fits is the Wooded RV/Tent Site w/Electric at $35/night + tax ('Accommodates 30-35ft campers or Tents'); suggest nightly_low 35. Either way under US$50.
Minor: the Ways to Camp page heads 'Open from Mid April to End of October', while the homepage gives the 2026 season as 'Thursday, April 9 through Sunday, November 1' (the entry's 04-09 to 11-01).
